from PIL import Image

# Open logo.png
img = Image.open\('logo.png'\)

# Convert to RGB \(ICO format needs RGB, not RGBA\)
if img.mode == 'RGBA':
    rgb_img = Image.new\('RGB', img.size, \(255, 255, 255\)\)
    rgb_img.paste\(img, mask=img.split\(\)[3]\)
else:
    rgb_img = img

# Resize to 32x32 \(standard favicon size\)
favicon = rgb_img.resize\(\(32, 32\), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS\)

# Save as ICO
favicon.save\('favicon.ico', 'ICO'\)

print\("✅ favicon.ico created successfully!"\)
print\(f"Size: {favicon.size}"\)

# Also create other common sizes
sizes = [16, 32, 64]
for size in sizes:
    resized = rgb_img.resize\(\(size, size\), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS\)
    resized.save\(f'favicon-{size}x{size}.png', 'PNG'\)
    print\(f"✅ favicon-{size}x{size}.png created"\)
EOF)
